song.title: Faith is the victory/ Encamped along the hills of light
song.lyrics:
[V1] . D D#/A A A7 D En - camped along the hills of light, ye Christian soldiers rise . D D/A A A7 D And press the battle ere the night shall veil the glowing skies . D/A A A7/D D A/E E7 A A - gainst the foe in vales be - low, let all our strength be hurled . D D/A A7 D Faith is the victo - ry we know that o - ver - comes the world
[C1] . D A7 G/D D Faith is the victory! Faith is the victo - ry . G D D/A A7 D Oh glorious vic - to - ry that o - ver - comes the world
[V2] . D D/A A A7 D His banner o - ver us is love, our sword the Word of God . D D/A A A7 D We tread the road the saints a - bove with shouts of triumph trod . D/A A A7/D D A/E E7 A By faith they, like a whirl-wind's breath swept on o'er ev - ery field . D G D/A A7 D The faith by which they con - quered death is still our shin - ing shield
[V3] . D D/A A A7 D On ev - ery hand the foe we find drawn up in dread ar - ray . D D/A A A7 D Let tents of ease be left be - hind and on - ward to the fray . D/A A A7/D D A/E E7 A Sal - va - tion's hel - met on each head, with truth all girt a - bout . D G D/A A7 D The earth shall tremble 'neath our tread and ech - o with our shout
[V4] . D D/A A A7 D To him that o - ver - comes the foe white rai - ment shall be giv'n . D D/A A A7 D Be - fore the an - gels he shall know his name con - fessed in heav'n . D/A A A7/D D A/E E7 A Then on - ward from the hills of light, our hearts with love a - flame . D G D/A A7 D We'll van - quish all the ghosts of night in Je - sus' con - quering name
song.author: John Henry Yates, Ira David Sankey
